tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Local Isometry Invariance of Jacobi Fields] 1. ch10:10.5If $\varphi :(M,g)\to (\widetilde M,\widetilde g)$ is a local isometry, $\widetilde\gamma =\varphi \circ \gamma $, and $d\varphi _{\gamma (t)}J(t)=\widetilde J(t)$, then $J$ is Jacobi if and only if $\widetilde J$ is Jacobi.
